title: Monarch CLI normalized account (v1)
description: Normative contract for one normalized account record emitted by `monarch accounts list` (and the same record shape inside account collections). Fields are always present; unavailable values are null. Unknown additive upstream fields never appear here because normalization discards them. This schema is additive-only: new optional properties may be added without a version change, but removing or renaming a property, narrowing nullability, tightening a type, or adding a required property requires a new schema version.

id.description: Upstream account identifier, or null when unavailable.

balance.description: Current balance in upstream numeric units; null when unavailable, never fabricated as 0.

is_active.description: False when the account is hidden. Absent or null upstream values default to true.

is_manual.description: True for manually tracked accounts. Absent or null upstream values default to false.

owner_id.description: Upstream ownedByUser.id, or null when no owner relationship was provided.

owner_name.description: Upstream ownedByUser.displayName, or null when no owner relationship was provided.

is_asset.description: Direct upstream isAsset classification; null when absent or non-boolean. Never inferred from display labels.

apr.description: Upstream apr in upstream numeric units.

interest_rate.description: Upstream interestRate in upstream numeric units.

excluded_from_debt_paydown.description: Upstream excludeFromDebtPaydown; null when absent or non-boolean.

last_updated.description: Upstream updatedAt timestamp, passed through literally.
